decisions.reason: As a newly launched bulk container very close to the core range and already given its own page, it is a low-cost adjacent option that a large growing firm would usually keep while market feedback is still unfolding.
The valve is an even more incremental extension of the established bulk-container business, so keeping it on the market preserves upside at little cost and complements existing products.

The take-back service is less established and only lightly presented so far, but because it fits the firm's strategic move toward reusable service-based packaging, management would likely keep the option open for another year despite higher uncertainty.
